chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said:
Indeed, part of a man's happiness is that his trade is in his own land, that his associates are righteous, and that he has children by whom he seeks assistance.

key_terms.الْمَرْءِ: the person or man being described
key_terms.خُلَطَاؤُهُ: his associates, companions, or business contacts
key_terms.مَتْجَرُهُ: his trade, business, or commercial livelihood
key_terms.يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِمْ: he is aided by them or seeks support through them

ai.seo_question: What things does Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام describe as part of a person's happiness?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies several worldly causes of a person's happiness: stable livelihood in one's own land, righteous companions in one's dealings, and supportive children. It presents well-being as being tied to sound social, economic, and family conditions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3598 - Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) said:
"Part of a man's happiness is that his business is in his own land, that his associates are righteous, and that he has children who assist him."
